name: M-VAVE FM-1 hub
device: M-VAVE FM-1 synth
what: one page listing a dozen open-source FM-1 firmwares (Felucca, SLOOP groovebox, zp12 sampler, X0X drums, Jangada drones...) with in-browser Web MIDI install. the page this one is modeled on.

name: Bruce

name: ESP32 Marauder
device: ESP32 dev boards, Flipper wifi dev board
what: wifi and bluetooth analysis suite for cheap ESP32 boards.

name: Tasmota
device: Sonoff and thousands of other ESP8266/ESP32 smart plugs and bulbs
what: local-control firmware for cheap wifi smart-home gear, with a browser installer.

name: ESPHome
device: ESP32 / ESP8266 sensors, switches, displays
what: describe a device in YAML, get firmware that talks to Home Assistant.

name: Meshtastic
device: LoRa boards: Heltec, LilyGO T-Beam, RAK, T-Echo
what: off-grid mesh text messaging over LoRa on $20-ish boards. browser flasher.

name: UV-K5 custom (egzumer)
device: Quansheng UV-K5 handheld radio
what: one of the best-known community firmwares for the cheap UV-K5: extra features, wider band coverage, spectrum view.

name: UV-K5 custom (armel)
device: Quansheng UV-K5 handheld radio
what: another fork in the UV-K5 family tree, with its own UI and feature set.

device: Pinecil, Miniware TS100 / TS80 soldering irons

name: Thingino
device: cheap Ingenic-based IP cameras (Wyze, Cinnamon and more)
what: open firmware for cheap cameras, local-only, no cloud account.

name: OpenIPC
device: IP cameras on Goke, HiSilicon, SigmaStar, Ingenic chips
what: a linux firmware project for the long tail of whitelabel IP cameras.

name: OpenWrt
device: hundreds of consumer routers and access points

name: Klipper

name: Marlin

name: Betaflight
device: FPV drone flight controllers
what: racing-quad flight control firmware, flashed from the browser configurator.

name: INAV
device: FPV drone and fixed-wing flight controllers
what: adds GPS navigation and return-to-home to hobby flight controllers.

name: ArduPilot
device: drones, planes, rovers, boats
what: autopilot firmware for nearly anything that moves.

name: Momentum
device: Flipper Zero

name: Unleashed
device: Flipper Zero
what: long-running Flipper Zero custom firmware with extended sub-GHz support.

name: Knulli
device: Anbernic and other budget retro handhelds

name: ROCKNIX
device: Anbernic, Powkiddy, AYN and other ARM handhelds
what: community linux distribution for a wide range of ARM retro handhelds.

name: ArkOS
device: Odroid Go Super and RK3326 handhelds
what: one of the older custom OS images for cheap Rockchip handhelds.

name: Rockbox
device: old iPods, Sansa, iriver and other DAPs
